capabilities.name: Find jobs and apply for you
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent find jobs that fit you and send the applications for you?

US.note: LoopCV searches US boards such as Dice and USAJobs, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you on its own by email or through the web forms it supports. Easy Apply jobs on LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice go through its browser extension instead. The job boards' own AI stops before the last step: the Indeed and ZipRecruiter apps in ChatGPT send you to their sites to apply, and LinkedIn's Premium Apply Assistant pre-fills forms that you approve.

GB.note: LoopCV searches UK boards such as Reed and CV-Library, plus LinkedIn and Indeed, and sends applications for you on its own by email or through the web forms it supports. Easy Apply jobs on LinkedIn, Indeed and Reed go through its browser extension instead. Indeed's Career Scout reached the UK in July 2026; it pre-fills applications that you send yourself.

capabilities.name: Run payroll and HR paperwork for a small business
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent run payroll or finish an HR task, such as filing a form, for a small business?

US.note: Gusto's agents run payroll after the owner confirms a preview, but only for some customers: Cofounder (launched June 2026) is in invite-only early access, and running payroll from the Gusto app in ChatGPT is open to select customers. Intuit's Payroll Agent in QuickBooks Workforce runs payroll for the owner, but Intuit said in May 2026 only that it would reach eligible US customers in the coming weeks.
